title: XRP Price Prediction: Descending Channel Points to Bounce as XRP Defends $0.98 Support
summary: XRP is hovering around the $1 mark after recently slipping below the psychological level, leaving traders focused on whether the cryptocurrency can stabilize near the $0.98 support zone.
content:
Skip to content
Assets: XRP

XRP is hovering around the $1 mark after recently slipping below the psychological level, leaving traders focused on whether the cryptocurrency can stabilize near the $0.98 support zone.

Short-term XRP price chart structures point to the possibility of a relief bounce, but broader technical indicators continue to show that sellers have the upper hand.

At the time of the latest TradingView snapshot cited in the analysis, XRP/USD was around $1.0026, up roughly 1.03%. The move followed a period of weakness that saw XRP test levels below $1. Recent market coverage also shows that the price has repeatedly tested the $1 area, highlighting its importance at both psychological and technical levels.

The setup leaves the XRP price caught between short-term rebound signals and a wider bearish structure. For traders assessing an XRP price prediction, the reaction around $0.98 could therefore become an important indicator of whether the current decline is entering a temporary consolidation phase or developing into another leg lower.

XRP Price Tests Descending Channel Support

On the one-hour chart, XRP has been moving inside a descending channel, with both the upper and lower boundaries guiding recent price action. CryptoAnalystSignal noted that the price had reached the channel’s lower boundary, where a reaction could develop.

XRP is testing the lower boundary of a descending 1-hour channel, with a potential bounce and retest ahead, while the RSI signals continued bearish momentum. Source: CryptoAnalystSignal on TradingView

The analyst described the setup as one in which XRP could bounce and eventually retest the channel boundary. Such a move would not necessarily confirm a trend reversal. Instead, it would represent a technical rebound within an existing declining structure.

The $0.9766 region is particularly important. The level has previously attracted buyers several times, making it a closely watched support area. A sustained defense of that zone could give the price room to recover toward the middle or upper portion of the short-term channel.

Conversely, a decisive move below $0.9766 would weaken the immediate rebound case. It could also shift attention toward lower support levels, particularly if selling volume increases alongside the breakdown.

$1 Remains a Critical XRP Price Level

The $1 threshold has become an important battleground for XRP. The token briefly fell below the level earlier this month, with recent market reports noting a low around $0.9889. The price has since recovered toward the round-number mark, but repeated tests suggest that buyers have not yet established a strong recovery above it.

XRP is testing the pivotal $1 level, with the broader bearish structure suggesting continued downside risk following repeated triangle consolidations and sharp sell-offs. Source: AnhbaCong_ on TradingView

The daily-chart analysis from AnhbaCong takes a more cautious view. It identifies $1 as a major demand area and argues that an immediate clean breakdown may be difficult while buyers continue defending the zone.

Under that scenario, XRP could remain range-bound between approximately $1 and $1.10 before establishing a clearer direction. The $1.10 region is significant because it also aligns with the 100-period moving average identified in the analysis.

A sustained move above $1.10 would therefore improve the short-term technical picture. Failure to reclaim that area, however, could leave the broader bearish structure intact.

Technical Indicators Remain Mixed

The latest TradingView readings provide a divided picture of the XRP price outlook.

The overall technical rating in the cited snapshot was Neutral, with 14 sell signals, seven neutral readings, and five buy signals. The moving-average group was considerably weaker, producing 13 sell signals, one neutral reading, and one buy signal.

XRP price chart. Source: Brave New Coin

That imbalance matters because the price remains below most of its major short-, medium-, and longer-term moving averages. The 10-period EMA and SMA were around $1.012 and $1.011, respectively, while the 20-period EMA and SMA were near $1.032 and $1.037.

Longer-period averages were positioned even higher. The 30-, 50-, 100-, and 200-period averages were all above the current XRP price, indicating that the broader trend remains under pressure.

TradingView’s current technical overview likewise warns that technical ratings should not be treated as standalone trading signals and that XRP’s one-week and one-month technical readings have recently carried a sell bias.

At the same time, several momentum indicators suggest that selling pressure may be becoming stretched.

The RSI was around 37.86, placing it in the lower half of its conventional range without reaching deeply oversold territory. The Stochastic %K was near 13.61, while Stochastic RSI Fast stood around 14.25. Williams Percent Range was also deeply negative at approximately -81.84.

These readings can be consistent with short-term stabilization after a decline. However, they do not guarantee a reversal. Momentum indicators can remain depressed while an asset continues to trend lower.

The MACD remained negative at roughly -0.025, reinforcing the view that downside pressure had not fully disappeared.

XRP Ledger Activity Diverges From Market Sentiment

On-chain data adds another layer to the XRP price prediction.

Santiment reported that negative XRP sentiment across social platforms had reached a three-month extreme as the token struggled around $1. At the same time, XRP Ledger activity increased significantly.

XRP Ledger activity rose to 49,929 active addresses in 24 hours, its highest level in more than two months, despite prevailing negative sentiment. Source: @SantimentData via X

On August 14, the network recorded 49,929 active addresses over a 24-hour period, the highest level in more than two months.

That divergence is notable because market sentiment and network participation are moving in different directions. Santiment’s data essentially shows that negative commentary has intensified even as more addresses have been active on the XRP Ledger.

Santiment defines its 24-hour active-address metric as the number of distinct addresses that participated in transfers during a rolling 24-hour period, with each address counted once.

Higher activity does not automatically mean that XRP is being accumulated. Addresses can become active because of transfers, selling, exchange movements, or other forms of network use. Still, the increase provides evidence that activity on the ledger has not simply disappeared alongside the price decline.

That distinction is important when evaluating an XRP forecast. Market sentiment can change rapidly, while on-chain participation offers another measure of what is happening beneath the price chart.

What the XRP Price Prediction Shows Next

The immediate XRP price outlook depends heavily on how the cryptocurrency behaves around $0.9766 and $1.

If buyers continue defending the $0.9766 support zone, XRP could attempt to reclaim $1.01-$1.04, where several short-term moving averages are currently positioned. A stronger recovery could then bring $1.10 into focus.

The $1.10-$1.12 area represents a more demanding resistance zone. The daily-chart analysis places the 100-period moving average around this region, while the cited setup identifies $1.10 as a key ceiling.

A sustained break above that resistance would weaken the near-term bearish structure and provide stronger evidence that the price is moving beyond its current consolidation.

On the other hand, a clear breakdown below $0.9766 would change the short-term picture. TradingView’s classic pivot levels place the next major support around $0.926, followed by approximately $0.764. These levels provide broader reference points if the $0.98 area fails.

For now, the evidence does not establish a confirmed bullish reversal. Instead, the token is showing a combination of oversold-style momentum readings, elevated XRP Ledger activity, and extremely negative sentiment against a still-bearish moving-average structure.

That makes $0.98 a key level to monitor. A successful defense could support a relief move toward $1.04 and potentially $1.10, while a decisive breakdown would strengthen the case for further downside.

The current XRP price prediction is therefore best viewed as a conditional setup rather than a fixed target: holding the $0.9766-$1 region keeps a short-term rebound scenario alive, but the price would need to reclaim successive resistance levels to demonstrate that the broader downtrend is losing control.

title: Ethereum (ETH) Price Prediction: ETH Volatility Compression Builds as Bulls Target $2,500 Recovery
summary: Ethereum is approaching a critical phase, holding key support levels as traders watch whether volatility compression can lead to a breakout towards the $2,500 recovery target.
content:
Skip to content
Assets: ETH

Ethereum is approaching a critical phase, holding key support levels as traders watch whether volatility compression can lead to a breakout towards the $2,500 recovery target.

Ethereum price has remained stuck in a tight trading range as volatility continues to fade, leaving traders waiting for the next major move. While the slow price action has limited momentum, ETH’s ability to hold key support and the recent rise in network activity have kept hopes of a stronger recovery alive. Brave New Coin data shows Ethereum trading around $1,905, with the asset attempting to hold after recovering from its recent lows.

ETH’s Volatility Points Towards a Larger Move

Ethereum price has entered one of its tightest consolidation phases recently, with price moving sideways as volatility continues to decline. Daan Crypto Trades highlighted that ETH has rarely remained compressed for such an extended period without eventually seeing a stronger expansion.

The current range leaves ETH with a clear technical battle ahead. Holding the $1,800-$1,850 support zone keeps the recovery structure intact, while a breakout above $1,950-$2,000 could trigger the next move higher towards $2,300-$2,500. A loss of the current support area, however, would weaken the bullish setup and increase the chances of ETH revisiting lower levels around $1,700-$1,750.

Ethereum price continues consolidating inside a tight range as traders wait for a volatility expansion. Source: Daan Crypto Trades via X

Ethereum Network Growth Adds Strength to Recovery Setup

Ethereum’s on-chain activity has also improved during the recent consolidation phase. Famous on-chain analyst Ali Charts highlighted that new daily ETH addresses increased from around 121,210 on August 8 to 212,560, showing a sharp rise in network growth.

Historically, stronger network participation has supported longer-term demand trends, although ETH still needs technical confirmation before this translates into a sustained price recovery.

Ethereum network growth has accelerated as daily new addresses increased significantly. Source: Ali Charts via X

For now, the improving fundamentals provide support for the bullish case, but the next major catalyst remains a breakout above overhead resistance.

ETH Holds Key Support as Bulls Eye $2,500 Target

Castillo Trading highlighted ETH’s current structure as a favorable risk-to-reward setup, with price holding above a previous support area after reclaiming the range. The chart shows Ethereum price defending the $1,800-$1,850 region, with the next major upside challenge sitting near $2,000. A successful reclaim of this level would strengthen the structure and open a move towards $2,400-$2,500, where previous resistance could slow the recovery.

Ethereum is holding above key support while targeting a retest of previous range highs. Source: Castillo Trading via X

As long as ETH remains above the current demand zone, the recovery scenario remains valid. A breakdown below this area would shift attention back towards lower support levels.

Ethereum Price Prediction Targeting $12K

Famous crypto commentator Ted Pillows highlights a long-term bullish scenario in which Ethereum price could significantly outperform if it catches up with the expansion of the global M2 money supply. According to the chart, ETH’s current structure remains supported by a rising trendline, while a recovery towards previous highs could eventually pave the way for much higher valuations.

The analyst suggests that if Ethereum follows global liquidity growth, the asset could move above $12,000 in the long term. However, ETH still needs to reclaim key resistance areas first, with $2,500-$2,800 acting as an important zone before a larger trend continuation can develop.

Ethereum could see significant upside if ETH tracks global M2 growth and breaks above major resistance levels. Source: Ted Pillows via X

Ethereum Price Levels to Watch

Ethereum price is approaching a key decision point after weeks of sideways trading.

  • Immediate support: $1,800-$1,850
  • Major resistance: $1,950-$2,000
  • First upside target: $2,300
  • Higher recovery target: $2,500-$2,800

A breakout above resistance with stronger volume would confirm that buyers are regaining control. Until then, ETH remains inside a consolidation range where both continuation and rejection scenarios remain possible.

Final Thoughts: Ethereum’s Next Big Move Could Be Near

Ethereum is entering a crucial stage as price compression reaches extreme levels and traders wait for the next major breakout. With ETH holding the $1,800-$1,850 support zone and network activity improving, a reclaim of the $1,950-$2,000 resistance area could put the $2,500 recovery target back in focus.

Ethereum price is trading at around $1,882, down 0.14% in the last 24 hours. Source: Brave New Coin

However, Ethereum price still needs confirmation before a stronger trend develops. A rejection from resistance or a breakdown below key support could delay the recovery and push price back toward lower levels. The coming weeks will likely decide whether Ethereum is preparing for a larger upside move or another period of consolidation.

title: Dogecoin (DOGE) Price Prediction: Whale Accumulation Builds as DOGE Targets $0.09-$0.12 Recovery
summary: Dogecoin is holding above critical multi-year support near $0.067-$0.070 as whale accumulation grows and traders target a recovery towards $0.09-$0.12.
content:
Skip to content
Assets: DOGE

Dogecoin is holding above critical multi-year support near $0.067-$0.070 as whale accumulation grows and traders target a recovery towards $0.09-$0.12.

Dogecoin is once again approaching a key turning point as DOGE holds above a major long-term support zone. Growing whale accumulation and a tightening higher-timeframe structure are now raising hopes that the meme coin could be preparing for a stronger recovery.

Dogecoin was trading at around $0.06991, up 0.20% in the last 24 hours at press time. Source: Brave New Coin

DOGE Attracting Interest Near Current Support

Dogecoin has spent several weeks trading near its recent lows, but the current positioning is beginning to attract traders seeking a defined recovery setup. Castillo Trading highlighted what he considers a favorable risk-to-reward opportunity, with DOGE sitting directly above a clear invalidation area.

The chart places nearby support around $0.07 region, while the first major recovery level sits close to $0.09-$0.095. If momentum expands beyond that resistance, the broader setup projects a move towards $0.118-$0.12.

Dogecoin is trading near a clearly defined support zone, with the technical setup targeting roughly $0.09 and $0.12 if a recovery develops. Source: Castillo Trading via X

The advantage of the setup is that downside risk remains relatively well defined. A decisive loss of the recent support base would invalidate the bullish thesis, while continued acceptance above it gives DOGE room to attempt a much larger mean-reversion move.

Whale Interest Adds Support to Bullish Dogecoin Outlook

On-chain positioning is also beginning to strengthen the recovery argument. Ali Charts reported that large Dogecoin holders accumulated more than 430 million DOGE over the past week.

The increase in whale holdings suggests larger participants have been adding exposure while price remains near depressed levels. The accompanying data shows whale balances rising from roughly the 18.5 billion DOGE region towards nearly 18.9 billion DOGE during the latest accumulation phase.

Whale accumulation alone does not guarantee an immediate price reversal, but sustained buying around major support can become more important if price begins reclaiming nearby technical resistance. A combination of rising large-holder balances and improving price structure would provide stronger confirmation that accumulation is translating into market demand.

Dogecoin whales accumulated more than 430 million DOGE over the past week as large-holder balances increased. Source: Ali Charts via X

Weak Trading Volumes Remain a Concern

Despite the improving long-term setup, Dogecoin is still struggling with one important issue of trading volume. Eliz highlighted that a technically strong DOGE setup recently failed because there was not enough volume to support the breakout. The chart shows price briefly pushing through descending resistance before falling back towards the $0.069 region. Rather than producing follow-through, the breakout attempt quickly lost momentum as participation remained weak.

This remains an important warning for the current Dogecoin price prediction. DOGE can continue forming constructive patterns, but a stronger recovery towards $0.09 and above will likely require a noticeable expansion in spot participation. Until volume improves, breakout attempts remain vulnerable to rejection.

DOGE failed to sustain a recent breakout attempt as weak volume limited follow-through above descending resistance. Source: Eliz via X

DOGE Targeting $0.10–$0.20 Breakout Zone

Dogecoin’s higher-timeframe structure is beginning to offer a much more interesting upside scenario. The Moon Show highlights DOGE compressing inside a large falling wedge while sitting directly on a multi-year support zone around $0.055-$0.060. This area has acted as an important historical base and is now intersecting with the lower boundary of the wedge. The chart suggests that holding this support and breaking the descending wedge resistance around $0.075-$0.080 could be the first major confirmation of a broader reversal, opening a path towards $0.10-$0.12 and then the $0.18-$0.20 region if momentum continues to build.

Dogecoin is compressing inside a higher-timeframe falling wedge directly above multi-year support. Source: The Moon Show via X

The longer-term projection becomes more aggressive if DOGE reclaims previous cycle resistance zones. A move through $0.20 could reopen $0.30-$0.35, with the broader cycle structure even allowing for a potential expansion towards $0.50-$0.70 and prior highs above $0.70 in a full bullish phase. For now, the bullish case depends on DOGE defending the $0.055-$0.060 base and eventually breaking the descending trendline to confirm a shift from accumulation into expansion.

$0.09 Becomes the First Major Dogecoin Recovery Target

The immediate technical challenge for DOGE is to move away from the $0.067-$0.070 support region and reclaim the resistance sitting overhead.

The first significant upside zone appears around $0.09-$0.095, which previously acted as an important range boundary. Reclaiming this area would represent a meaningful structural improvement and could allow DOGE to target the larger $0.115-$0.12 resistance region.

A move into the $0.09 region would represent roughly a 30% recovery from current prices, while the $0.12 target would require a considerably stronger expansion. Both scenarios become more realistic if whale accumulation continues and trading volume begins increasing alongside price.

Dogecoin Price Levels to Watch

The $0.067-$0.070 region remains the immediate area bulls need to defend. DOGE is currently trading directly around this base, making any sustained move below recent lows an important warning for the recovery setup.

  • A breakdown below $0.067 would likely invalidate the short-term bullish structure and expose DOGE to deeper downside pressure.
  • A strong expansion in volume above $0.09 would be a key confirmation that buyers are regaining control of the trend.

On the upside, the first meaningful resistance sits around $0.09-$0.095. Clearing that zone would improve the technical structure considerably and open the possibility of a move towards approximately $0.115-$0.12.

Final Thoughts: Dogecoin Recovery Towards $0.12?

A Dogecoin recovery towards $0.12 remains technically possible, particularly while DOGE continues to defend its multi-year support region and whale balances are increasing. The current price also offers a relatively clear invalidation point, while the falling wedge provides a higher-timeframe structure that could support a larger reversal if resistance eventually breaks.

However, volume remains the missing confirmation. DOGE first needs to move convincingly away from the $0.067-$0.070 base and reclaim $0.09-$0.095 with stronger participation. If that happens, the $0.115-$0.12 region would become a much more realistic next target. A loss of the current support base, however, would weaken the recovery thesis and keep Dogecoin exposed to another leg lower.

title: Worldcoin (WLD) Price Prediction: Ascending Triangle Signals Potential $0.40 Breakout Amid Grayscale ETF Filing and Supply Cuts
summary: Worldcoin (WLD) is showing signs of a potential recovery after a sharp decline in July, with traders now watching whether the token can overcome a key resistance zone and extend its rebound toward $0.40.
content:
Skip to content
Assets: WLD

Worldcoin (WLD) is showing signs of a potential recovery after a sharp decline in July, with traders now watching whether the token can overcome a key resistance zone and extend its rebound toward $0.40.

The improving setup comes as several fundamental developments have changed the backdrop for WLD. Grayscale has filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) for a spot Worldcoin ETF, while World has reduced the token’s scheduled daily unlock rate. At the same time, Eightco Holdings has continued to maintain a large WLD treasury position.

Technical analysts are also monitoring an ascending triangle formation, although the pattern has not yet produced a confirmed breakout. The combination of improving supply dynamics and renewed institutional interest therefore provides a stronger fundamental backdrop, but WLD still faces important technical resistance.

WLD Price Builds an Ascending Triangle

A TradingView analysis by analyst wolf_king888 describes WLD as forming an ascending triangle after what the analyst considers the end of its previous downtrend.

The analyst wrote that, from a structural perspective, the prior downtrend had ended and that a break above the pattern’s resistance could increase the probability of further gains. The analysis also noted that an ascending triangle is generally viewed as a bullish continuation or reversal structure.

The analyst says WLD’s previous downtrend may have ended, with an ascending triangle signaling potential further gains if the price breaks and holds above resistance. Source: wolf_king888 on TradingView

However, the pattern alone does not confirm a rally. WLD still needs to clear the upper boundary with sustained buying activity before the technical setup can be considered a confirmed breakout.

WLD has recovered from its late-July low near $0.30 and is now testing the key $0.3496–$0.3560 resistance zone on the 4H chart after breaking below its descending trendline. Source: BKVIP on TradingView

A separate four-hour analysis by BKVIP identifies the $0.3496-$0.3560 area as the immediate resistance zone. WLD has tested this region several times since recovering from the late-July breakdown, with sellers repeatedly pushing the token back toward the $0.3300-$0.3320 support area.

A decisive four-hour close above $0.3560 would therefore provide the first meaningful confirmation that the range is resolving higher.

Worldcoin Price Prediction: $0.40 Comes Into Focus

The technical structure gives traders several levels to monitor before a potential move toward $0.40.

According to the TradingView setup, a sustained move above $0.3560 could expose the $0.3600-$0.3650 area. Clearing that zone would put the $0.3800-$0.3900 region next, followed by the previous range around $0.4200-$0.4400.

That makes $0.40 an important psychological and technical threshold rather than an isolated price target.

The structure remains two-sided, however. A rejection from $0.3496-$0.3560 followed by a break below $0.3300-$0.3320 would keep WLD inside its established range. A deeper move below $0.3060-$0.3100 could then bring the $0.2960-$0.3000 breakdown area back into focus.

This distinction is important for the WLD price prediction because the ascending triangle remains unconfirmed until buyers establish control above resistance.

Grayscale Files for a Spot WLD ETF

The fundamental backdrop improved in July when Grayscale filed a registration statement with the SEC for a Worldcoin ETF.

Grayscale filed an S-1 with the SEC on July 20, 2026, for a proposed spot Worldcoin ETF, GWLD, which would hold WLD directly and trade on Nasdaq, with BitGo as custodian and BNY Mellon as administrator. Source: @0xc06 via X

The proposed product would hold WLD directly and, if approved, would trade on Nasdaq under the ticker GWLD. The filing represents a potential route for traditional-market investors to gain exposure to WLD through an exchange-traded product.

The filing initially produced a noticeable market reaction. Decrypt reported that WLD gained roughly 8% following the announcement, reaching an intraday high near $0.387. The move demonstrated that the ETF filing was capable of attracting immediate speculative demand, although subsequent price action showed that the catalyst alone was not enough to establish a lasting uptrend.

The ETF remains a proposal rather than an approved investment product. Its potential impact on WLD demand therefore depends on the regulatory process and whether the fund ultimately launches.

WLD Supply Pressure Falls

Another important development for the Worldcoin price prediction is the scheduled reduction in WLD emissions.

World’s tokenomics schedule reduced the aggregate daily unlock rate by 43% on July 24, from approximately 5.1 million WLD to 2.9 million WLD. The community allocation saw the largest adjustment, falling from about 3.2 million tokens per day to 1.6 million, while team and investor emissions declined from roughly 1.9 million to 1.3 million WLD per day.

Worldcoin (WLD) price chart. Source: Brave New Coin

The change means fewer newly unlocked tokens are scheduled to enter the market each day. Based on the published schedule, the reduction represents roughly 803 million fewer tokens entering the unlock schedule over a year.

World’s own documentation also states that there are no unlock cliffs for the relevant team and investor allocations under the extended lock-up arrangements, with the scheduled rate declining automatically according to the existing timetable.

That does not eliminate selling pressure. It simply reduces the rate at which scheduled supply becomes available, leaving actual market demand as the key factor determining whether the lower emission rate translates into sustained price support.

Eightco Maintains a Large WLD Position

Institutional exposure provides another notable element in the WLD market.

Eightco Holdings disclosed nearly 302 million WLD in its treasury as of July 26, according to a company announcement. That represents a substantial position in the token and makes Worldcoin a central component of the Nasdaq-listed company’s digital-asset strategy.

Earlier SEC filings showed Eightco holding 283.45 million WLD as of July 8, representing approximately 8.1% of the circulating supply at the time. The company described the position as the largest publicly disclosed institutional WLD holding.

The size of the position is significant, but it should not automatically be interpreted as evidence that WLD will appreciate. Eightco’s reported exposure has also been subject to substantial mark-to-market fluctuations as the token’s price moved lower and then recovered.

Instead, the holding illustrates the growing presence of corporate treasury strategies around Worldcoin and its broader proof-of-humanity thesis.

Technical Signals Remain Mixed

Despite the improving short-term setup, WLD’s technical picture is not uniformly bullish.

The TradingView data referenced in the analysis shows a neutral overall reading in the displayed snapshot, while its accompanying methodology indicates a Buy rating on the daily timeframe and Sell ratings over one-week and one-month periods. This divergence suggests that short-term momentum has improved without yet establishing a broader trend reversal.

World Network eased supply pressure by cutting its aggregate daily WLD unlock rate 43%, from approximately 5.1 million to 2.9 million tokens. Source: @10xResearch via X

That distinction is particularly relevant after WLD’s sharp decline earlier in the year. A short-term recovery can develop within a larger bearish trend, meaning resistance levels remain important confirmation points.

Historical price data also shows the extent of the recent volatility. WLD traded near $0.44 in early July before falling toward the $0.30 area later in the month. CoinGecko’s historical data shows WLD closing at $0.3815 on July 23 before dropping to roughly $0.3443 on July 25 and $0.3269 by July 27.

The subsequent recovery has therefore taken place after a significant drawdown rather than within an established long-term uptrend.

WLD Price Prediction: Levels to Watch

For the bullish scenario to gain credibility, WLD first needs to overcome the $0.3496-$0.3560 resistance zone identified by the four-hour chart.

A confirmed move above $0.3560 could shift attention toward $0.3600-$0.3650. If buyers maintain momentum beyond that region, the next resistance sits around $0.3800-$0.3900.

A move through $0.3900 would bring the $0.40 psychological level into play and potentially expose the $0.4200-$0.4400 area seen earlier in July.

The bearish scenario is equally clear. Failure to break resistance, followed by a move under $0.3300-$0.3320, would indicate that sellers remain active within the range. A break below $0.3060-$0.3100 would weaken the recovery structure further and raise the possibility of a retest of $0.2960-$0.3000.

Outlook for Worldcoin

Worldcoin enters the next phase of its recovery with a combination of technical and fundamental factors that were not present at the July lows.

The Grayscale ETF filing has introduced a potential institutional-access catalyst, while the 43% reduction in scheduled daily emissions has improved the token’s supply profile. Eightco’s large treasury position also demonstrates continued corporate exposure to WLD and the broader world ecosystem.

Still, none of these developments guarantee a sustained price increase. The ETF remains subject to the regulatory process; lower emissions do not automatically create demand, and the ascending triangle requires confirmation through price action.

For the WLD price prediction, $0.3560 is therefore the critical near-term threshold. A sustained breakout could strengthen the case for a move toward $0.40 and potentially higher resistance levels, while another rejection would leave WLD vulnerable to a return toward its established support zones.

title: Bits of Gold Breach May Expose 200,000 Crypto Users, But Funds Remain Safe Online
summary:
Key Takeaways: A data breach at Bits of Gold could affect up to 200,000 customers. No exposure of customer funds, crypto assets, passwords or private keys. Phishing and impersonation attacks
The post Bits of Gold Breach May Expose 200,000 Crypto Users, But Funds Remain Safe Online appeared first on ...
content:
Key Takeaways:

  • A data breach at Bits of Gold could affect up to 200,000 customers.
  • No exposure of customer funds, crypto assets, passwords or private keys.
  • Phishing and impersonation attacks are still a primary concern after the potential data leak.

Israel-based crypto broker Bits of Gold is investigating a security incident involving unauthorized access to a third-party system used for data analysis and support. The company said its core crypto assets and customer accounts remain secure, but some personal information may have been accessed.

  • Customer Data May Have Been Exposed
    • Bits of Gold Under Investigation
  • Funds and Crypto Assets Were Not Affected

Customer Data May Have Been Exposed

Bits of Gold said the incident occurred several days before it notified customers and was connected to a wider cyberattack involving a software provider used by multiple companies worldwide.

Upon detection, the company blocked the unauthorized access and cut off the affected system from its information sources. It has also engaged a third party cybersecurity expert to investigate the hack and alerted the appropriate authorities.

Potential information potentially accessible via the compromised system can contain complete names, identification numbers, email addresses, telephone numbers, IP handle, banking details, and public cryptocurrency wallet addresses.

According to Israeli media reports, approximately 200,000 customers may be impacted. But Bit of Gold hasn’t made public any final tally of users that have been affected. Its investigation is still in progress, the company says.

Read More: Trezor Data Breach Exposes 13,689 Users, Crypto Wallets Remain Safe From Attack

Bits of Gold Under Investigation

However, according to the information cited in the local press, Bits of Gold is one of Israel’s established regulated crypto companies and has over 300,000 registered customers.

The company said it would establish what information was viewed, just how many customers were impacted and whether any data was deleted from the system. The 200,000-customer number has not been independently verified and the company is still investigating the impacted third-party system.

Funds and Crypto Assets Were Not Affected

Bits of Gold stated that the incident was not related to customer funds or digital currencies.

The company had also stated that account passwords, private keys, ID-entrat door scans, full credit card information and the Cvv codes were not leaked. It doesn’t store any private keys or full card details.

There is also no evidence that the potentially exposed data has been used against customers so far. The trading services of Bits of Gold are unaffected and customers should not have to act as a result of the incident, the company said.

title: SafePal Data Breach Exposes 39,798 Crypto Customers, Wallet Keys Remain Secure
summary:
Key Takeaways: About 39,798 users’ personal and purchase information were disclosed via a flaw in an order tracking plugin, according to SafePal. The incident affected orders placed between March 2,
The post SafePal Data Breach Exposes 39,798 Crypto Customers, Wallet Keys Remain Secure appeared firs...
content:
Key Takeaways:

  • About 39,798 users’ personal and purchase information were disclosed via a flaw in an order tracking plugin, according to SafePal.
  • The incident affected orders placed between March 2, 2025, and April 11, 2026.
  • While no seed phrases, private keys, wallet passwords, payment data and government IDs have been leaked, users are at a greater risk of being phished, says SafePal.

SafePal has announced a security breach with customer data related to purchased online orders, creating new phishing concerns for crypto users.

Dear community,

While your SafePal wallet, seed phrase, and private keys are secure; we identified a flaw in the order-tracking plug-in that led to unauthorized access to information of a subset of customers.

The issue has been fixed with additional security measures…

— SafePal – Crypto Wallet (@SafePal) August 16, 2026

The company has stated that it did not have its wallet infrastructure breached and that there is no personal data that gives users direct access to their cryptocurrency assets.

  • Order-Tracking Flaw Exposed Customer Data
  • Crypto Wallets and Private Keys Were Not Exposed
    • Seed Phrases Remain Outside the Breach
    • SafePal Adds Security Measures

Order-Tracking Flaw Exposed Customer Data

SafePal states it happened because of a bug in an ordering tracking plugin for its ecommerce platform. This was because that section of customers was in a position to access the information, thanks to the vulnerability.

Around 39,798 consumers might have been impacted from March 2, 2025, to April 11, 2026.

The leaked information included customers names, e-mail address, shipping address, phone numbers, and purchase information. SafePal stated that it has reached out to affected users one by one through e-mail.

The company has additionally delivered a page online where consumers can examine if their details were included in the order by entering their Order ID and country of shipping.

Read More: Trezor Data Breach Exposes 13,689 Users, Crypto Wallets Remain Safe From Attack

Crypto Wallets and Private Keys Were Not Exposed

Seed Phrases Remain Outside the Breach

SafePal emphasized that it was not a seed phrase, private keys or wallet password leak. Details of bank accounts and payment cards or government identification were also not compromised, the company said.

These differences count a great deal for crypto users. The personal information on an order does not establish proof of identity or credentials to take control of the payment funds in a SafePal wallet.

Therefore, SafePal advised customers to pay more attention to phishing and impersonation activities, rather than rushing to transfer their assets.

Scammers may use legitimate names, addresses and buying details to forge legitimate messages. If not customers, attackers can pretend to be SafePal staff or customers’ delivery companies, or even Pacific support team, and ask customers to disclose wallet details.

Read More: Binance Blocks 11 Crypto Platforms in Major Compliance Move Affecting User Funds

SafePal Adds Security Measures

SafePal claims that this vulnerability has already been patched and further security measures have been added.

The company also reminds the users to be vigilant about unsolicited messages, emails and websites. Customers should never provide their seed phrase, private key or wallet password to anyone, even if the request appears to come from SafePal support.

SafePal has released a special scam-protection page for the hit customers and will be releasing additional information via its security channels.

The incident demonstrates a reoccurring vulnerability faced by hardware-wallet users: swept lines of customer data can provide researchers with a trick of what can essentially be a highly targeted attack.

title: Coinbase Unveils AiFi After $100M in x402 Transactions, Targeting AI Agent Payments
summary:
Key Takeaways: Coinbase has announced the launch of its financial infrastructure initiative, AiFi, centered on the new AI agent economy. It handles over $100 million in payments via its x402
The post Coinbase Unveils AiFi After $100M in x402 Transactions, Targeting AI Agent Payments appeared first o...
content:
Key Takeaways:

  • Coinbase has announced the launch of its financial infrastructure initiative, AiFi, centered on the new AI agent economy.
  • It handles over $100 million in payments via its x402 payment standard and has 90% of on-chain agentic stablecoin volume on Base.
  • Coinbase is growing its AI agent payments business using USDC, Coinbase Business, CDP x402 SDK and collaborations, such as AWS.

Coinbase is more confident that AI agents can do more than just craft responses; they can research, decide, purchase services, and transact funds. The exchange is consolidating them in a new feature and service called AiFi.

Read More: Coinbase Launches Bitcoin Security Consortium to Shield $2T Network From Quantum Threats

  • Coinbase Builds a Financial Layer for AI Agents
  • x402 Turns AI Agents Into Paying Customers
    • USDC Payments Move Into the Agent Economy
    • Agentic.Market Adds a Discovery Layer

Coinbase Builds a Financial Layer for AI Agents

Coinbase describes the agent economy as having three main participants: people using AI agents, businesses selling services to them, and developers building the underlying tools.

AiFi is already happening.

And when agents need money, they choose Coinbase ↓ pic.twitter.com/nkWdJJXwfU

— Coinbase 🛡️ (@coinbase) August 15, 2026

The reason for users is that this allows AI agents to do research, planning, decision-making, and trading in cryptocurrencies, stocks, and derivatives and other finances. Coinbase has also launched Coinbase Advisor, an AI-powered investment advisor within its app.

The larger emphasis is, however, providing agents with access points to payments, without needing to resort to traditional, agent-dependent checkout methods.

x402 Turns AI Agents Into Paying Customers

Coinbase claims its x402 protocol offers an open standardized protocol for machine-to-machine payments. It can be utilized by AI agents to make payments directly, without any human having to authorize each transaction.

Since its launch last year, the company indicated x402’s transaction volume is already over $100 million. It also states that 90% of transaction volume of on-chain agentic stablecoins is now being processed on Base, Coinbase’s Ethereum Layer-2 solution.

Now, Coinbase is collaborating with companies such as AWS to seamlessly allow AI agents to make instant payment for the services they utilize.

Read More: Coinbase Opens India’s $4T Economy to Crypto With Direct INR Rails and Futures Trading

USDC Payments Move Into the Agent Economy

Coinbase Business is also being sold as the payment rails for businesses that cater to AI agents. Without defining a separate payment flow, businesses can receive USDC from business agents via x402 support.

Coinbase has a number of features highlighted, including no original charge-back risk, 3.35% rewards for holding idle USDC, and tools to manage, reconcile and withdraw from one account.

Coinbase has also released the Coinbase Developer Store (CDP x402) SDK for developers, enabling the inclusion of payments from their agents in API or MCPs with minimal code added. That reduces the technical hurdle for developers who wish to deploy their applications and have automated payments taken without being versed in the x402 protocol.

Agentic.Market Adds a Discovery Layer

Money alone should never be considered if agents can’t find services to procure. Coinbase is also tying up at the Agentic.Operate as a discovery service for x402-compatible services. Payment flow is simple: agents start finding available services, pinpoint what services they require, and make the payment automatically.

Instead of marking AI payments as a stand-alone crypto product, Coinbase is seeking to build an end-to-end program around the idea of financial transactions, stablecoin payments, developer infrastructure, and service discovery, specifically through AiFi.

title: Dario Amodei’s Unusually Personal Case for AI
summary: Dario Amodei has spent years warning that advanced AI could be dangerous. In a rare exchange on X, Anthropic’s chief executive made a more demanding case for the technology: public trust will not be won with safety messaging or glossy promises, but by delivering something concrete—starting with medi...
content:
Skip to content

Dario Amodei has spent years warning that advanced AI could be dangerous. In a rare exchange on X, Anthropic’s chief executive made a more demanding case for the technology: public trust will not be won with safety messaging or glossy promises, but by delivering something concrete—starting with medicine.

Dario Amodei does not tend to litigate his reputation in public. Anthropic’s chief executive has built his case for artificial intelligence in dense essays, policy papers and carefully paced interviews—not through the combustible back-and-forth of X.

That is why his recent exchange, prompted by criticism of Anthropic’s safety politics and his own supposedly gloomy rhetoric, matters. It was not simply a CEO defending his company. It was Amodei setting out a sharper theory of what AI’s legitimacy will require: less persuasion, more proof.

1/2 Thanks Gavin for an especially thoughtful exchange. I don’t usually spend much time on social media but I wanted to engage here because it really brings out the heart of an important conversation. First, on regulation, I think that “either concentrate it in the hands of a Show more

Gavin Baker
@GavinSBaker

Sholto, thank you for setting the record straight. Larger issue is that multiple very serious people in Silicon Valley have heard some variation of this and believe it to be true. And the reason it is believable to so many is that it is consistent with Dario’s public messaging.

1/2 Thanks Gavin for an especially thoughtful exchange. I don’t usually spend much time on social media but I wanted to engage here because it really brings out the heart of an important conversation.

First, on regulation, I think that “either concentrate it in the hands of a… https://t.co/2W6vWJAE8Y

— Dario Amodei (@DarioAmodei) August 15, 2026

“The thing that will work is actually curing cancer,” he wrote in the exchange. It is a deliberately blunt answer to a question that has stalked the industry since generative AI became a mass-market phenomenon: why should the public trust companies asking for extraordinary resources, regulatory influence and tolerance for disruption?

Amodei’s answer is that it should not—not yet. “I think by far the most accurate criticism of AI companies including Anthropic is that we haven’t yet delivered on our big promises to benefit the world,” he continued. “That is totally on us.”

That is more candid than the standard Silicon Valley response, but it is also a high-stakes promise. Anthropic is no longer asking to be judged solely as the cautious laboratory in the race to build advanced AI. Increasingly, it is asking to be judged as the laboratory that can turn advanced AI into a public good—most visibly through biology and medicine.

Why Amodei was moved to respond

The exchange emerged from a familiar criticism. Anthropic has become the most conspicuous advocate for taking the risks of frontier AI seriously: risks in cyber security, biology, misuse, loss of control and the concentration of power. For supporters, that makes the company a necessary corrective to an industry too eager to call every increase in model capability “progress.” For critics, it can look like a safety argument that conveniently strengthens the hand of the companies wealthy enough to build closed, tightly controlled systems.

The company’s position in the recent open-weight-model dispute made that suspicion more acute. Amodei argued that Anthropic had never advocated a ban on open-weight models, while also insisting that the most capable systems should be subject to mandatory safety testing. It is a defensible distinction. But it leaves Anthropic occupying an awkward political position: opposed to a blanket ban, yet sceptical of the idea that wider access to frontier capabilities is inherently good.

The social-media criticism that drew Amodei out was broader. Why, critics asked, was Anthropic so focused on disaster scenarios? Why did its leaders seem to see the dangers of AI so clearly while selling the same technology to businesses and governments? And why should the public accept its safety agenda as altruism rather than regulatory capture?

Amodei’s reply was not to deny the trust problem. “I do agree that the public has a negative view of AI,” he wrote. But he rejected the proposition that this was chiefly the result of AI leaders warning too loudly about risk.

“I think it is fundamentally a crisis of trust,” he said. “I think that ordinary people don’t trust companies, governments, or the tech industry and always suspect that we are cooking up some new way to screw them over.”

That may be the most revealing sentence in the exchange. It concedes that Anthropic is operating in an environment where technical assurances will not be enough. The problem is not simply that people misunderstand AI; it is that they have good reasons to be suspicious of institutions that promise social transformation while accumulating vast capital, computing infrastructure and influence.

A case against marketing

Amodei’s proposed answer is strikingly anti-promotional. “I don’t think that a glitzy marketing campaign with a positive spin … is the way to win back that trust,” he wrote. At this point, he argued, claims that AI will cure cancer sound less like inspiration than cliché.

That is a pointed departure from the dominant tone of the AI boom. Across the industry, the future is routinely invoked as evidence for the present: automation will make everyone richer; models will unlock science; intelligence will become nearly free. The commercial logic is obvious. The social logic is much harder.

Amodei is not retreating from those claims. In fact, his views about AI’s upside remain among the most expansive in the industry. In his 2024 essay, Machines of Loving Grace, he argued that sufficiently powerful AI could accelerate biology, medicine, economic development and governance on a scale that now sounds fantastical. He envisaged a “country of geniuses in a datacenter”—millions of highly capable systems able to work in parallel, not merely answering questions but designing experiments, writing software and directing research.

The essay was partly an effort to correct the view of Amodei as a pessimist or “doomer.” “I think most people are underestimating just how radical the upside of AI could be,” he wrote, while adding that people also underestimate the risks.

The recent X exchange clarifies the relationship between those two ideas. Amodei does not believe a sunny campaign should precede the benefits. He believes the benefits must arrive first.

That is a much more demanding standard than the industry has generally applied to itself. It also creates an obvious vulnerability. If Anthropic makes biology and medicine central to its public case, it will eventually be judged against outcomes that are difficult to exaggerate and impossible to ship as a software update.

The biology bet

Amodei’s focus on medicine is not incidental. Before co-founding Anthropic, he trained as a biophysicist, earned a doctorate from Princeton and worked as a postdoctoral researcher at Stanford’s medical school. In the exchange, he explained the personal urgency behind his optimism, writing that his father died of hepatitis C only a few years before direct-acting antivirals transformed treatment.

That experience has long shaped his view of technological progress. In Machines of Loving Grace, Amodei argues that AI should not be understood as a tool that merely analyses biological data. A sufficiently powerful system, he says, could act more like a virtual biologist: proposing hypotheses, designing experiments, improving measurement methods and coordinating laboratory work.

The result, in his most optimistic formulation, could be a “compressed 21st century” in which decades of medical progress arrive in five to ten years. He has suggested that most disease could become preventable or treatable in that period—an enormous claim, and one that he acknowledges is uncertain.

His recent comments suggest Anthropic now wants to turn that theory into a more immediate corporate priority. “Anthropic is ramping up its efforts very quickly in biology and medicine,” Amodei wrote, adding that the company hopes for “incredible results in the coming years and some early glimmers in the coming months.”

The language is unusually concrete, if still carefully non-specific. It signals not only a research interest but an intention to establish a public track record. “When we’ve actually accomplished something real, the whole world will hear about it, as loudly as possible,” Amodei wrote. “But until then I don’t want to make empty promises.”

The unresolved tension

That final qualification matters because it exposes the tension at the heart of Anthropic’s position. The company wants to be seen as both more responsible than its rivals and more ambitious than the cautious label suggests. It warns that frontier AI may create severe cyber, biological and alignment risks. At the same time, it believes similar systems could dramatically speed the development of life-saving treatments.

The practical question is who gets to decide how those systems are used, and on what terms. Anthropic has already shown a willingness to draw bright lines in government work. In a February statement, Amodei endorsed the use of Claude in US defence and intelligence settings, while refusing use for mass domestic surveillance or fully autonomous weapons. He described those limits as essential to democratic values and technological reliability.

But this does not dissolve the concern about concentration. A company can be sincere about safety and still acquire extraordinary power by becoming the arbiter of safe use. It can promise medical abundance while restricting access to the most capable models. It can call for faster approval of AI-accelerated drugs while raising understandable questions about who bears the risks when regulatory systems are streamlined.

Amodei’s response does not resolve those contradictions. It does, however, make them more visible. For years, Anthropic’s implicit pitch has been: trust us because we are the lab taking danger seriously. Amodei’s latest intervention adds a second proposition: trust will have to be earned through tangible benefits, not safety rhetoric alone.

That is a more accountable promise than a slogan about AI changing everything. It is also one with a very clear test. If Anthropic helps produce genuine biomedical advances, and those advances are widely accessible, it will have a powerful answer to the charge that AI is primarily a machine for concentrating wealth and influence.

If it does not, then the sentence designed to cut through the marketing noise—“actually curing cancer”—will read less like a standard of proof than another grand promise from an industry that has made many.

title: Crypto Exchange Sign-Up Bonuses Explained: How to Get Free Bitcoin in 2026
summary:
A crypto sign-up bonus is a reward that a crypto exchange offers to new users for opening an account and completing certain tasks. You may need to verify your identity,
The post Crypto Exchange Sign-Up Bonuses Explained: How to Get Free Bitcoin in 2026 appeared first on CryptoNinjas.
content:
A crypto sign-up bonus is a reward that a crypto exchange offers to new users for opening an account and completing certain tasks. You may need to verify your identity, deposit funds, make a trade, or reach a set trading volume to claim the reward, and the bonus may come as Bitcoin, stablecoins, trading vouchers, fee rebates, or locked bonus credit.

If you are new to crypto exchanges or comparing platforms before you join, this guide explains how crypto welcome bonuses work, the main types of sign-up rewards, and the actual form each reward takes. You will also learn how to get free Bitcoin as a sign-up bonus, how much it may cost to clear the requirements, where these offers face restrictions, and which crypto exchange sign-up promotions in 2026 are worth checking if you want extra value or lower trading costs.

  • What Is a Crypto Exchange Sign-Up Bonus?
    • What Are the Benefits of a Crypto Welcome Bonus?
    • Is a Sign-Up Bonus the Same as a Welcome Bonus?
    • Why Can You See the Bonus but Not Withdraw It?
  • What Types of Crypto Exchange Sign-Up Bonuses Are There?
    • Registration Bonuses (No Deposit Needed)
    • Deposit Bonuses
    • Trading Volume Bonuses
    • Task and Learn-to-Earn Bonuses
    • Trading Fee Discounts and Cashback
  • What Form Does the Reward Actually Take?
    • Cash or Stablecoin
    • Locked Trading Vouchers and Bonus Credit
    • Fee Rebates and Discount Tiers
  • How to Get Free Bitcoin as a Sign-Up Bonus?
    • Can You Claim More Than One Bonus on the Same Exchange?
    • How Much Does It Cost to Clear a Bonus?
  • Where Are Crypto Sign-Up Bonuses Restricted or Banned?
    • Does Using a VPN Void the Bonus?
  • What Are the Best Crypto Exchange Sign-Up Promotions in 2026?

What Is a Crypto Exchange Sign-Up Bonus?

A crypto exchange sign-up bonus is free crypto, trading credit, or a fee discount that an exchange gives a new user for opening an account and completing a few onboarding steps.

The exchange sets the rules, and most platforms only ask for some basic stuff to start, like your email, then your phone number, and a government ID for verification. Usually, basic no-deposit rewards are around $5 to $50. But, on the other hand, trading volume bonuses on platforms made for active traders can go up to thousands of dollars in USDT.

What Are the Benefits of a Crypto Welcome Bonus?

The benefits of a crypto welcome bonus are free crypto rewards, lower starting costs, reduced trading fees, a chance to test the exchange, and extra value from your first deposit or trades.

  • Free Crypto Bonus: A welcome bonus can easily give you some extra crypto, stablecoins, or reward credit after you complete the required tasks.
  • Lower Starting Costs: A bonus can reduce the amount of your own trading capital you need to use while trying an exchange. You see, a $10 or $20 reward may not look large, but it can obviously help cover your first few trades, especially for beginners who want to start with a small amount.
  • Reduced Trading Fees: Generally, some welcome offers include fee rebates, cashback, or trading vouchers instead of direct crypto. Now, these rewards can be more useful for active traders because every trade normally comes with a maker or taker fee, and repeated fee savings can really add up over time.
  • A Chance to Test the Exchange: A welcome bonus gives you an extra reason to test the platform before committing more money. You can check the trading tools, order execution, available markets, deposits, and withdrawals while completing the bonus requirements.
  • Extra Value From Your First Deposit or Trades: Deposit and trading bonuses can give you additional value on activity you were going to do anyway. It’s better to get a reward for depositing $100 than make unnecessary trades just to unlock a bonus. So you should pick a promotion that fits in with your regular trading plans, rather than changing your strategy just for the reward.

Is a Sign-Up Bonus the Same as a Welcome Bonus?

A sign-up bonus and a welcome bonus usually mean the same thing, but an exchange may use the names for different campaigns. Normally, both terms describe an incentive for a new customer.

Actually, the small difference comes from how the platform builds the offer. A “sign-up bonus” may refer to one reward linked to a referral code. A “welcome bonus” may cover a group of tasks inside the ‘Rewards Hub’, such as KYC, first deposit, first trade, and volume targets. But again, other platforms reverse those labels, so the name alone tells you very little.

Why Can You See the Bonus but Not Withdraw It?

You can see a bonus but fail to withdraw it because the exchange gave you restricted credit rather than cash or crypto that you own. The number still appears in your wallet or “Rewards Hub”, but the platform controls how you can use it. Well, crypto exchanges use several labels for this kind of reward: futures bonus, trial fund, position voucher, fee saver, rebate card, copy-trading bonus, and loss-cover credit. The credit can cover trading fees, funding fees, or losses, but you can never withdraw it.

What Types of Crypto Exchange Sign-Up Bonuses Are There?

The types of crypto exchange signup bonuses include registration bonuses, deposit bonuses, trading volume bonuses, task and learn-to-earn bonuses, and trading fee discounts or cashback.

Registration Bonuses (No Deposit Needed)

A registration bonus is a small amount of crypto you get just for creating and verifying an account during account registration, and these offers do not even require a minimum deposit. It’s the simplest bonus type out there, and it exists mainly to get you comfortable enough with a platform to explore it further.

Here, rewards are usually modest, often somewhere between $5 and $50, and they typically land after you complete KYC verification as part of identity verification. Nowadays, true no-deposit crypto bonuses have become less common because, you know, people can create fake accounts and farm the reward. So, platforms now use identity checks, device checks, and one-account rules to control that abuse.

Deposit Bonuses

A deposit bonus is a reward you get for depositing a required amount of fiat or crypto in an exchange and keeping enough net funds in the account, and some platforms require you to deposit cryptocurrency rather than only cash to qualify. The exchange may pay a fixed reward, a percentage match, or a tiered amount based on the deposit size.

Some promotions also expect you to start trading or begin buying crypto after funding the account, rather than leaving the balance idle.

Also, for most exchanges, net deposit matters as well. The platform usually subtracts instant withdrawals. So, a $500 deposit followed by a $200 instant withdrawal may count as only $300, which is why it’s smart to compare the bonus amount with the platform’s withdrawal rules before choosing an offer.

Trading Volume Bonuses

A trading volume bonus is a crypto exchange reward that you earn after completing a required amount of trading within a set period. Well, this is where the biggest headline numbers in the industry come from (like a $30,000 USDT Bybit bonus). Exchanges often set a time limited window to complete the required trading activity.

Exchanges built for active traders often advertise totals in the thousands of USDT, but that full amount is almost always tied to trading volume milestone tiers. Also, they mainly count spot trading and futures trading volume only. So, zero-fee stablecoin pairs, Convert orders, API trades, copy trades, or trades made with another voucher may not count, and qualifying volume may only be measured during that set period.

Task and Learn-to-Earn Bonuses

Task and learn-to-earn bonuses are the rewards you get for completing simple tasks or short lessons. Here, the most common tasks include passing KYC, adding two-factor authentication, watching a video, answering a quiz, making a first buy, trying a feature, checking in for several days, or using the crypto.com app for app-based onboarding rewards, with cro tokens offered in some cases.

These tasks generally offer the safest path because they do not always require heavy trading. These bonuses may arrive as a small token, points, a mystery box, an APR booster, or a voucher.

Trading Fee Discounts and Cashback

A trading fee discount or cashback bonus lowers what you pay to trade instead of handing you a lump sum upfront, and active traders can earn rewards through ongoing fee reductions over time. It might show up as a lifetime 10% or 20% discount on trading fees when you sign up with a “referral code”, or as a small cashback percentage paid back in stablecoin on every trade you make.

Some fee discounts are temporary, while others last for an extended period depending on the promotion or your trading level.

There’s no big number to brag about here, but it’s arguably the most valuable bonus type for anyone who plans to trade regularly, since the savings compound the more you use the platform.

What Form Does the Reward Actually Take?

A crypto sign-up reward does not always come as withdrawable cash, and exchanges may give you cash or stablecoins, locked trading vouchers or bonus credit, or fee rebates and discount tiers.

Cash or Stablecoin

Cash or stablecoin rewards provide the best value because the exchange credits a real asset after you qualify. It may pay fiat, USDT, USDC, BTC, CRO, or another token. The exact asset obviously depends on the offer and your country.

Locked Trading Vouchers and Bonus Credit

Locked trading vouchers and bonus credit, including bonus credits, let you trade or cover trading costs, but they do not give you withdrawable principal. These credits may come with usage limits or an expiration date. The exchange may use the credit as margin or apply it to fees, funding charges, and realized losses. Also, some offers let you withdraw profit earned with the trading voucher.

Fee Rebates and Discount Tiers

Fee rebates return part of the trading fees you pay, while discount tiers reduce your trading rate for a fixed period or trading volume. Usually, these rewards make more sense for active traders because the benefit grows as you place more trades, although some rebates or discount tiers only apply to certain order types and a market order may be required under specific promotions.

How to Get Free Bitcoin as a Sign-Up Bonus?

You can get free Bitcoin as a sign-up bonus by opening a new exchange account, applying the correct referral or promo code, and completing the required tasks before the offer expires. It is not really free money, because you still need to meet the platform’s conditions before the reward has practical value. The steps below cover the whole process:

Step 1: Register a new account and apply the referral code. The easiest way is to use the exchange’s unique referral link or enter the referral code during the sign-up process. Also, most free BTC offers only work for new users, so an old account normally cannot claim the same welcome bonus.

Step 2: Complete identity verification. The exchange may ask you to complete identity verification and KYC verification before it unlocks the promotion. You usually need a valid ID and basic personal details.

Step 3: Make the required deposit/ Most of the exchanges will ask you to deposit a minimum amount, such as $10, $50, or $100. Generally, deposit rules can change between promotions.

Step 4: Complete the trading requirement. Now, you need to buy Bitcoin, make your first trade, or reach a fixed trading volume, as required by the exchange. Anyone trying to get free crypto for signing up should check this type of condition very carefully because the largest advertised reward often requires more trading volume.

Step 5: Claim the Bitcoin reward. Finally, go to the “Rewards Hub” or promotion page of that exchange after completing the tasks. The exchange may credit Bitcoin directly or sometimes give you a reward voucher that you need to claim before its expiration date.

Can You Claim More Than One Bonus on the Same Exchange?

No, you generally can’t claim more than one sign-up bonus on the same exchange. You see, most platforms limit these offers to one per person, one per household, one per IP address, and one per payment method, and they enforce it using device fingerprinting, ID checks, and payment tracking to catch duplicate accounts.

Hence, opening a second account to farm another crypto sign-up bonus almost always breaks the platform’s terms, and it can even get both accounts frozen if it’s caught.

How Much Does It Cost to Clear a Bonus?

Clearing a bonus usually costs you in trading fees and time, since many exchanges require you to trade somewhere between 10 and 50 times the bonus value before you can touch it.

For example: a $100 bonus with a 20x requirement means trading $2,000 in volume before it fully unlocks, and you know, every one of those trades still carries its normal fee.

You can use this simple estimate:

Total bonus cost = trading fees + spread and slippage + funding fees + deposit and withdrawal costs + price loss + possible tax cost. Crypto bonuses work best when the offer is worth more than the fees and slippage needed to unlock it.

Where Are Crypto Sign-Up Bonuses Restricted or Banned?

Crypto sign-up bonuses are not available in any country that has a full crypto ban, and top exchanges also strictly limit these offers in highly regulated markets (like the US, UK, and Europe) even if crypto is legal there.

Countries that completely ban crypto trading include China, Algeria, Bolivia, Egypt, Iraq, Nepal, Qatar, Morocco, Tunisia, Afghanistan, and Kuwait, so no real exchange can offer bonuses or run promotions in these places. Now, on top of that, major exchanges also block sanctioned regions like Iran, Cuba, Syria, North Korea, and Crimea. This means users from these areas cannot sign up or claim rewards at all.

  • The United Kingdom: The FCA’s crypto promotion rules block common sign-up and referral incentives for retail users.
  • The United States: Crypto offers mainly depend on the exchange and state here. Actually, New York comes closest to a practical barrier, since its BitLicense rules are tough enough that a handful of large exchanges skip the state entirely or limit what’s on offer there.
  • The European Economic Area: The offer can change by country, licensed exchange entity, and product. But if an exchange is MiCA-licensed, it may offer these bonuses.

Does Using a VPN Void the Bonus?

Yes, using a VPN to fake your location and claim a geo-restricted bonus almost always voids it and can get your account suspended too.

You see, every major exchange’s terms of service ban faking your location, and VPN use for exactly this purpose is one of the more common reasons bonuses get clawed back. Here’s the thing, though: a VPN only hides your IP address, not your identity, since your KYC documents already tie your account to your real address and citizenship.

So exchanges can often catch the mismatch anyway, even with a VPN active. Hence, getting caught usually means bonus forfeiture, and in more serious cases, a frozen or suspended account.

What Are the Best Crypto Exchange Sign-Up Promotions in 2026?
